svg.title: VeraCrypt hidden-volume concept
svg.desc: Nesting denotes storage containment, not inherited unlocking. Plausible deniability is not guaranteed invisibility; temporary files, snapshots and outer-volume writes still need attention.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: Has its own password and holds ordinary protected data
Occupies free space inside the outer volume and uses a different
password; unlocking the outer volume does not unlock it
Nesting denotes storage containment, not inherited unlocking.
Plausible deniability is not guaranteed invisibility; temporary files
, snapshots and outer-volume writes still need attention.
